First, calculate the difference in years, months, and days between the debut and final game dates. WITH date_conversion AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        debut::DATE AS debut_date,
        final_game::DATE AS final_date,
        date_diff('year', debut::DATE, final_game::DATE) AS year_diff,
        date_diff('month', debut::DATE, final_game::DATE) AS month_diff,
        date_diff('day', debut::DATE, final_game::DATE) AS day_diff
    FROM player
    WHERE debut IS NOT NULL AND debut != '' AND final_game IS NOT NULL AND final_game != ''
),
career_span AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        ROUND(ABS(year_diff), 2) AS year_span,
        ROUND(ABS(month_diff) / 12.0, 2) AS month_span,
        ROUND(ABS(day_diff) / 365.0, 2) AS day_span,
        ROUND(ABS(year_diff) + ABS(month_diff) / 12.0 + ABS(day_diff) / 365.0, 2) AS career_span
    FROM date_conversion
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(AVG(career_span), 2) AS avg_career_span
FROM career_span
